title: Asana
description: Move beyond the physical and understand Asana as a meditative state of being—steady, comfortable, and perfectly balanced.

sutra.meaning: Yama (moral injunctions), Niyama (observances), Āsana (posture), Prāṇāyāma (regulation of breath), Pratyāhāra (withholding of senses), Dhāraṇā (fixity of attention), Dhyāna (meditation), and Samādhi (absorption of consciousness in the self) are the eight accessories (limbs) of Yoga

sections.practice: attempt to take up one new practice or change in lifestyle in accordance with yamas and niyamas
sections.gurudevInsight: The husk is gone, the sprout moves though it & comes up. They are (1) Yama (2) Niyama (3) Aasana (4) Pranayama (5) Pratyahara (6) Dhyana (7) Dharana (8) Samadhi. He goes into the details of each & what is the result that you can expect from each one of them. Yoga has 8 limbs, like a chair has got four legs, yoga has 8 limbs, or legs. So you just pull 80 one, everything else will come down. If you pull one leg of the chair whole chair comes. [PDF p.80]

sutra.meaning: The posture should be steady and comfortable.

sections.gurudevInsight: samadhisiddhiishwarapranidhana - By one pointed devotion to the Divine, Samadhi comes about. 3) Aasana: - Sthiramsukhamasana - That which is steady & which is comfortable is the asana. Normally, when we are comfortable, we are not steady, we are not sitting erect but when we are erect, we are so stiff, we are not comfortable. But asana is when you are both steady & comfortable, you are erect, steady & at the same time comfortable. Prayatnashaitalya anant samapattibhaam - Letting go the effort, main point of it & feeling the body, letting go the effort & experiencing the infinity. Have you noticed, after you do asanas, how it feels? [PDF p.91]

sutra.meaning: It results in relaxation of effort and the meeting with the infinite.

sections.insight: Yogic practices should feel pleasureable to be sustained.

sections.gurudevInsight: Satyapratisthayaam kriyaphalashay Established in Truth, your actions will become fruitful, any act you do that will be fruitful. See, many people do their actions but their actions does not bring results because there in no truth consciousness inside. When there is truth consciousness inside, established in truth, then the fruit of action will follow the action immediately – kriyaphalashaya - success in action comes. [PDF p.82]

sutra.meaning: From then on, there are no botherations from the dualities like happiness and distress, heat and cold.

sections.gurudevInsight: Keeping personal hygiene in very essential; shaucha & Mind also clean – antahshaucha bhaayabrantarashaucha – outer cleanliness & inner cleanliness, mind being free from tensions. b) Santosha: - Contentment, happiness, happiness again is an attitude. If you are used to be unhappy in best of situations you’ll still grumble & be unhappy. You know, you did this exercise this morning keeping a smile & breathing & just enjoy your breath. [PDF p.87]

sutra.meaning: Once this is accomplished, regulation of the incoming and the outgoing breath with retention is attained.

sections.insight: Prana is the all permeating, auto generated  energy which sustains and destroys life. It is also at the heart of the practice of yoga.  Pranayama consists of prana + ayama ie regulation. Prana is vital to maintaining life and the systems of the body. Pranayama helps to keep its free flow.

sections.shlokaFrom: अपाने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणेऽपानं तथापरे |प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणा: || 29|| अपरे नियताहारा: प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति |सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषा: || 30||
sections.wisdomFrom: Still others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming breath, while some offer the incoming breath into the outgoing breath. Some arduously practice prāṇāyām and restrain the incoming and outgoing breaths, purely absorbed in the regulation of the life-energy. Yet others curtail their food intake and offer the breath into the life-energy as sacrifice. All these knowers of sacrifice are cleansed of their impurities as a result of such performances.
sections.gurudevInsight: If you are used to be unhappy in best of situations you’ll still grumble & be unhappy. You know, you did this exercise this morning keeping a smile & breathing & just enjoy your breath. See, when you are happy, what is happening? There is so much relaxation on the face, in the muscles of the face, in the head everywhere, there is freedom, there is joy, there is relaxation & you train your muscles & your nervous system being unhappy, that same thing continues. There are knots & stresses on your face, stiffness in your head, stiffness in your body & you remain unhappy irrespective of situations, surroundings, whatever. [PDF p.87]
